field_changes.old:
MyNetDiary is the calorie tracker and food diary you'll actually stick with: fast, accurate, and ad-free. Log your food in seconds with the free barcode scanner, Meal Scan, or quick search. Then get on with your day.

Proven Weight Loss Results
• Active members lost an average of 1.4 lbs per week (MyNetDiary Efficacy Report).
• Over 32 million users have chosen MyNetDiary for calorie tracking, weight loss and healthy eating - many switched from other diet and nutrition apps.

Recognized Excellence
Ranked #1 in Forbes Health's Best Weight Loss Apps of 2025. Scored highest of 30 apps for behavioral strategies in the American Journal of Preventive Medicine. The New York Times called it simpler, quicker, and better-looking than the competition. Featured in Today's Dietitian.

Why People Switch
Accuracy: MyNetDiary runs on a staff-verified food database of over 2 million foods with up to 108 nutrients per entry, from USDA and NCC research-grade sources, for accurate calorie, macro and micronutrient tracking. Most apps rely on crowdsourced data full of duplicates and errors. We review 2,500-3,500 foods daily.

Speed: In our January 2026 test, we logged 127 foods in every major app. MyNetDiary took 31% fewer taps than the most popular calorie tracker.

Free Calorie Counter - weight loss made simple
• Food diary with favorites, recent meals, and copy-from-day.
• Free barcode scanner with accurate nutrition data from the verified food database.
• Food Label scanner: snap any food label to log its nutrients instantly.
• Full macro and protein tracking.
• Accurate nutrition tracking for free, with no ads: up to 108 nutrients (vitamins, minerals, omegas, amino acids).
• Exercise tracker.
• Water tracker.
• Calorie calculator, deficit tracking, and customizable weight loss dashboard.
• Daily diet coaching tips, meal reminders, shopping lists.
• Professional Connect: share your food diary with your dietitian, coach, or doctor. Used by dietitians and health professionals at no cost.
• Community with daily success stories.
• Nutrition articles by Registered Dietitians.
Wear OS watch app with tiles & complications: log foods by voice, track water and weight, macro summary.
• Health Connect and Samsung Health sync: automatic exercise, steps, and weight.

MyNetDiary Premium - unlock the full power of your diet and nutrition app
• Meal Scan: photograph your plate and log it instantly, matched against the staff-verified database.
• Fitness Tracker Sync: Fitbit, Garmin, and Withings for automatic exercise calories and steps.
• GLP-1 Companion: nutrition-first support for Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound, and other semaglutide or tirzepatide medications, with protein targets and muscle protection while you lose weight.
• Macro tracking and planning, calorie and macro cycling.
• Autologging: your regular meals (foods, amounts, days, mealtimes) logged automatically.
• Intermittent fasting.
• Diet Autopilot: your calorie budget adjusts as you lose weight.
• Advanced Autopilot adapts to your actual metabolism.
• Health tracking: measurements, blood pressure, cholesterol, blood glucose, A1C, ketones, medications.
• Trend Analysis: optimize your diet and reach your goal weight.
• Meal Planner.
• Recipe import with nutrient counts.
• 600+ recipes and diet plans by Registered Dietitians: High-Protein, Mediterranean, Low-Carb, Keto, and more.

Premium Plus is your AI-powered weight loss journey
• MyNetDiary AI Diet Coach: built on 20 years of weight loss expertise, with daily guidance based on what you actually ate.
• AI Suggest Meals: smart meal suggestions tailored to your diet, calorie budget, and food preferences.
• AI Voice Food Logging: describe your meal out loud and MyNetDiary logs it.
• AI Restaurant Menu Scan: find the best options for your diet when eating out.

Results may vary. MyNetDiary does not provide medical advice. All product names, logos, and brands are the property of their respective owners.
